text:
jess_support: Hey team — multiple customers in eu-west reported a sudden quality regression and 500 spikes around 08:12 UTC. They claim responses are shorter, sometimes tokenization garble, and one customer saw a billing anomaly (lots of tokens charged). Can eng/runtime take a look? @riley_eng @akito_ops

riley_eng: Thanks. Any request IDs or example payloads?

jess_support: Pasting a repro curl from one customer (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_***' 
 -H 'Region: eu-west' 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"Summarize the following: ..."}'
```
Their error + response bodies:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"incompatible tokenizer for served model (vocab mismatch)", "request_id":"req_8b3c"}
```
And one successful but degraded response returned very short output and odd spacing: "Summarize:

 - Too short"

akito_ops: I see route traces for that window — requests from eu-west were routed to standby eu-north-1 due to a brief capacity alarm. Standby cluster was running a fallback image flagged as `redwood-13b-quant-lite-v2` (quantized, different tokenizer config).

maria_sre: That explains the tokenizer mismatch. Was there an automated promotion during the incident?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted image redwood-13b-quant-lite-v2 to eu-north-standby at 2026-03-12T08:09:42Z (trigger: autoscale failover test). No rollout to primary clusters recorded.

riley_eng: Oof — autoscale testing promoted the quantized lite image to standby but the routing policy didn't filter by tokenizer-compat metadata. When standby served requests, the runtime didn't translate token IDs and returned text with spacing/invalid tokens.

jess_support: Customer also reported a billing spike — they got charged for a lot more tokens than expected in that timeframe (their app retried on 500s). Could be retry loop + long tokenized input?

akito_ops: Confirmed higher retry counts in logs between 08:12 and 08:16. Retry policy kicked in on 500s and clients retried, and the quantized variant's tokenization produced longer token sequences for same text -> higher billed tokens.

riley_eng: Immediate mitigation: 1) pin routing to model family (exclude quantized-lite) for eu-west while we fix tag filtering; 2) rollback standby image to redwood-13b-v1; 3) add a compatibility check pre-route (tokenizer hash match).

maria_sre: I'll apply a temporary route policy to prefer primary region for existing customers and block eu-north-standby until we validate tokenizer parity.

jess_support: Helpdesk steps for affected customers: 1) issue a credit for the token overcharge window (08:12-08:20 UTC) 2) advise them we fixed routing and are rolling rollback 3) request a sample request/req_id if they still see bad outputs.

riley_eng: For postmortem: we need a gating test before any image promotion to standby clusters that verifies: model version, tokenizer checksum, and embedding dimension if applicable. Also telemetry to flag sudden token count deltas per-request-id.

akito_ops: Repro steps for eng to validate locally:
```
# emulate route to standby image
curl -X POST https://staging-eu-north.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer test' \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"}'
# check tokenization: expected token count: 9, standby returns 12
```

riley_eng: I'll take the lead on a quick fix. Plan: block quant-lite in routing config, rollback standby image, and add a pre-route tokenizer checksum check (low-risk hotfix). Will follow up with a short incident note.

jess_support: Thanks — I'll start customer comms and crediting. Please post the rollback time and final root cause so we can close tickets. :handshake:

maria_sre: Rollback applied at 08:28 UTC, routing policy updated 08:31 UTC. Monitoring shows token counts and 500s back to baseline.

riley_eng: Root cause summary (draft): standby cluster promotion during autoscale test deployed a quantized-lite image lacking tokenizer parity metadata. Routing logic allowed serving from standby without validating tokenizer compatibility, causing tokenization mismatches, short/garbled outputs, client retries, and billing spikes. Remediation: routing filter, checksum check, gating for standby promotions, and customer credits.

jess_support: Great. I'll paste this into the support tickets and follow up on credits. Closing thread once postmortem link is up.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback complete for eu-north-standby at 2026-03-12T08:28:43Z (image: redwood-13b-v1).
